id.privacy.title: Privasi & Keamanan Data
id.privacy.sub: Bagaimana Generate Soal Ujian menjaga data Anda.
id.privacy.intro: Generate Soal Ujian menghargai privasi pengguna. Aplikasi ini dirancang agar seluruh data soal yang Anda buat tetap berada di bawah kendali Anda — tersimpan secara lokal di perangkat, tanpa dikirim ke server mana pun secara otomatis.
id.privacy.sec1b: Aplikasi berjalan sepenuhnya di browser Anda. Isi soal, gambar, dan pengaturan dokumen tidak dikirim ke server secara otomatis — tidak ada akun, tidak ada pelacakan isi dokumen. Jangan menyimpan informasi pribadi atau data sensitif yang tidak diperlukan di dalam soal.
id.privacy.sec2b: Seluruh file soal disimpan menggunakan localStorage browser, sehingga data tetap tersedia ketika halaman direfresh atau browser ditutup lalu dibuka kembali. Perlu diperhatikan:
id.privacy.li1: Data terikat pada browser dan perangkat yang Anda gunakan saat ini.
id.privacy.li2: Data tidak otomatis berpindah ke browser atau perangkat lain.
id.privacy.li3: Menghapus data browser (cache / site data) dapat menghapus seluruh data yang tersimpan secara lokal.
id.privacy.sec3b: Anda adalah pemilik penuh atas data Anda. Anda dapat membuka, mengubah nama, menduplikat, dan menghapus file soal kapan saja melalui halaman Bank Soal. Untuk data yang penting, Anda bertanggung jawab melakukan backup — misalnya dengan mengekspor lembar soal ke PDF secara berkala.
id.privacy.sec4b: Menghapus file soal di Bank Soal akan menghapusnya secara permanen dari perangkat. Anda juga dapat menghapus seluruh data lokal aplikasi sekaligus melalui tombol di bawah ini. Data yang telah dihapus tidak dapat dikembalikan.
id.privacy.dangerText: Menghapus semua data akan membersihkan seluruh file soal dan pengaturan yang tersimpan di perangkat ini.

en.privacy.title: Privacy & Data Security
en.privacy.sub: How Generate Soal Ujian protects your data.
en.privacy.intro: Generate Soal Ujian respects user privacy. This app is designed so that all question data you create stays under your control — stored locally on your device, never automatically sent to any server.
en.privacy.sec1b: The app runs entirely in your browser. Question content, images, and document settings are never automatically sent to a server — no accounts, no tracking of document content. Do not store unnecessary personal or sensitive information in questions.
en.privacy.sec2b: All question files are stored using the browser's localStorage, so data remains available when the page is refreshed or the browser is closed and reopened. Please note:
en.privacy.li1: Data is tied to the browser and device you are currently using.
en.privacy.li2: Data does not automatically move to other browsers or devices.
en.privacy.li3: Clearing browser data (cache / site data) may delete all locally stored data.
en.privacy.sec3b: You are the full owner of your data. You can open, rename, duplicate, and delete question files at any time from the Question Bank page. For important data, you are responsible for making backups — for example by exporting exam sheets to PDF regularly.
en.privacy.sec4b: Deleting a question file in the Question Bank removes it permanently from the device. You can also delete all of the app's local data at once using the button below. Deleted data cannot be recovered.
en.privacy.dangerText: Deleting all data will remove all question files and settings stored on this device.

en.help.title: How to Use BuatSoal
en.help.sub: A quick flow for creating an exam sheet from start to print-ready.
en.help.s1d: On the Home page, click the "Multiple Choice" or "Essay" card to open the question form.
en.help.s2d: Write the question. For multiple choice, add an image (optional), set the number of options A–Z, image size, and 1 or 2 column layout. Click "Done" to save.
en.help.s3d: Saved questions appear in the "Question List" panel. Use the Edit, Duplicate, Delete, or ↑/↓ arrow buttons to arrange the order.
en.help.s4d: The "Exam Sheet Preview" panel shows the final result in A4 format. Use the zoom buttons to zoom in/out, and the Desktop/Mobile toggle to switch view modes.
en.help.s5d: When everything looks right, click "Export PDF" to download your exam sheet file.
